## Investigation Report

### Verdict / Confidence / Severity / Task Type

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | **CONFIRMED** |
| Confidence | **HIGH** |
| Severity | **LOW** |
| Task Type | **Focused unit test** |

### What Was Claimed

Issue `#25` requests one focused unit test proving that the review gate requires human intervention for a non-protected integration branch when automatic merge is not authorized. The test must pass `autoMergeAuthorized: false`, return `needs-human`, and identify the integration branch in its reason without changing production code or unrelated tests.

### What We Found

`test/core/review.test.ts` already provides the `input()` fixture with a non-protected integration branch (`staging`), complete reviewers, passing required checks, mergeable state, a valid lease, and `autoMergeAuthorized: true` by default. The existing suite covers the approved clean integration path, blocking conditions, finding behavior, and protected-branch human gating, but does not cover the disabled auto-merge path.

`evaluateReviewGate()` in `src/core/review.ts` appends `Automatic merge is not authorized for ${input.baseBranch}.` for an unprotected base when `autoMergeAuthorized` is false, then returns `needs-human` when no blocking or change-request conditions apply. The implementation already satisfies the requested behavior; only regression coverage is missing.

### Root Cause

The review-gate behavior for disabled automatic integration merges is implemented but untested. Without a focused test, a future change could accidentally approve an otherwise clean non-protected integration review when auto-merge authorization is absent.

### Affected Files

| Path | Role | Planned Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test/core/review.test.ts` | Review-gate unit tests | Add one focused test only |
| `src/core/review.ts` | Existing gate implementation | No change |

### Evidence

- `test/core/review.test.ts` defines `input()` with `baseBranch: "staging"`, `protectedBranches: ["main"]`, and `autoMergeAuthorized: true` defaults.
- `test/core/review.test.ts` contains `protected branches always require a human`, but no test sets `autoMergeAuthorized: false` for an unprotected branch.
- `src/core/review.ts` checks protected branches first and otherwise emits `Automatic merge is not authorized for ${input.baseBranch}.` when authorization is false.
- `src/core/review.ts` returns `{ decision: "needs-human", ... }` when the human-gating reasons are present and no higher-priority block/change condition exists.
- `forge_diff` reports no pre-existing worktree diff against frozen base `d617631b60ae8b084d231c224b8eee19722a406f`.

### History Findings

No pre-existing local changes were found. The current test organization places the protected-branch gate at the end of `test/core/review.test.ts`; the new disabled-authorization case can sit beside it without altering shared fixtures or production behavior. No historical implementation change is required by this issue.

### Recommendation

Add one test immediately after the protected-branch case. Invoke `evaluateReviewGate(input({ autoMergeAuthorized: false }))`, assert `result.decision === "needs-human"`, and assert the reason collection contains `staging`. Keep the patch limited to `test/core/review.test.ts`.

### Related Issues

No related issue or dependency was identified during repository inspection.

### Decomposition Assessment

This is a single-concern, single-file test change. Further decomposition would add process overhead without reducing risk.

### Acceptance Spec

- [ ] The test calls the existing `evaluateReviewGate` helper through `input({ autoMergeAuthorized: false })`.
- [ ] The base branch remains the non-protected integration branch `staging`.
- [ ] The decision is asserted as `needs-human`.
- [ ] The reason is asserted to name `staging`.
- [ ] Only `test/core/review.test.ts` changes; `src/core/review.ts` and unrelated tests remain untouched.
- [ ] No local verification commands are configured; parent-owned GitHub CI will run `npm run check` after PR preparation.

<!-- INVESTIGATION:COMPLETE -->

## Builder Contract

### Objective

Add regression coverage for the existing review-gate rule that a clean, non-protected integration review requires a human when automatic merge authorization is disabled.

### Allowed Scope

| Item | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| Allowed file | `test/core/review.test.ts` |
| Allowed symbol | One new `node:test` case using the existing `input()` fixture and `evaluateReviewGate()` |
| Production code | Read-only; do not modify `src/core/review.ts` |
| Test helpers | Reuse existing `input()`; do not refactor shared fixtures |
| Dependencies/config | No changes |

### Required Behavior

- Invoke `evaluateReviewGate(input({ autoMergeAuthorized: false }))`.
- Preserve the fixture's non-protected integration branch `staging`.
- Assert the result decision is exactly `needs-human`.
- Assert at least one returned reason names `staging`.

### Prohibited Changes

- No production-code changes.
- No changes to unrelated tests, package metadata, configuration, generated files, or workflow artifacts.
- No weakening or alteration of existing assertions.
- No new dependency or broad test-suite refactor.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] One focused disabled-auto-merge integration test is present.
- [ ] `autoMergeAuthorized: false` is passed to the existing helper path.
- [ ] The test asserts `needs-human`.
- [ ] The reason assertion names `staging`.
- [ ] The final diff contains only `test/core/review.test.ts`.
- [ ] Parent-owned GitHub CI validates `npm run check`; no local verification command is configured.

### Risk Controls

The test must leave all other gate inputs at their clean defaults so a failure identifies the authorization branch rather than stale state, missing reviewers, failed checks, conflicts, or findings.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT -->
## Implementation Context

`input()` in `test/core/review.test.ts` is the canonical clean review-gate fixture. It sets `baseBranch` to `staging`, excludes `staging` from `protectedBranches`, and enables auto-merge by default. The existing protected-branch test demonstrates the neighboring human-gated assertion style.

`evaluateReviewGate()` checks stale/lease/mergeability/check/finding failures before evaluating branch authorization. With the default clean fixture and only `autoMergeAuthorized` overridden to false, the expected result is `needs-human` with the exact reason `Automatic merge is not authorized for staging.`. The implementation is already correct and must remain unchanged.

### Verification Context

The repository defines `npm run check` as typecheck plus the complete test suite, but this run has an empty local verification allowlist. Do not invoke `forge_verify`; record local verification as not configured and defer authoritative `npm run check` enforcement to the parent-owned GitHub CI gate.

<!-- FORGE:CONTEXT:COMPLETE -->

<!-- FORGE:ARCHITECT -->
## Implementation Plan

1. Insert one test after `protected branches always require a human` in `test/core/review.test.ts`.
2. Call `evaluateReviewGate(input({ autoMergeAuthorized: false }))` without changing any other fixture input.
3. Assert `result.decision` equals `needs-human`.
4. Assert `result.reasons` contains a reason matching `staging`, proving the integration branch is named.
5. Inspect the diff to confirm only the approved test file changed.
6. Create the implementation commit, prepare the PR, and run the required fresh correctness/security review panel against the prepared head.

### Review and Remediation Boundary

Review findings may be fixed directly only when they concern this in-contract test change and do not alter product behavior, scope, UX, protected-branch policy, or security authority. Any such fix requires a review-fixes commit and a fresh full panel. Out-of-contract findings are escalated to the parent.
